Sweep smoke, fog, dust, rain and airborne poison from up to six connected squares. Sustain the clear air with a Maneuver each turn.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Up to six connected visible air-filled squares within 4 squares.
Limits
Maintain one current at a time.
Type
Magic / Utility / Control

Maintain a current of breathable air through the chosen air-filled squares. Ordinary smoke, fog, dust, rain and airborne poison are swept from those squares until the end of your next turn. On later turns, you may spend a Maneuver to sustain the current until the end of your next turn.
